name: vfs-dms-chatgpt-plugin
description: Read-only VFS DMS access for ChatGPT and Codex through the shared VFS MCP Server.

interface.shortDescription: Read company DMS repositories through VFS MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to the read-only VFS DMS tools already used by Demi. The plugin talks only to VFS MCP Server; credentials and DMS providers remain behind Provider Bridge.
